title: Ashbury Rewards Co-Brand Cards and Free Night Awards Rebooked Nights
content:
A linked co-brand card lowers the rebooked night's price when a member applies one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation. The card reduction is the premier card rebooking reduction when the membership's linked co-brand card is the Ashbury Rewards Premier Card, the standard card rebooking reduction when it is the Ashbury Rewards Card, and nothing when none is linked. It is taken off the rebooked night's price once.

| Linked co-brand card on the Ashbury Rewards membership | Card reduction on the rebooked night |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card | 1500 points (premier card rebooking reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Card | 500 points (standard card rebooking reduction) |
| None linked | No card reduction |

### Cases (hypothetical members)

- A member whose membership shows the Ashbury Rewards Premier Card linked: 1500 points come off the rebooked night's price.
- A member whose membership shows the Ashbury Rewards Card linked: 500 points come off.
- A member with no co-brand card linked: nothing comes off for a card.
